script: NFP is in minutes. Quick quiz — where does price go FIRST before the real move? Think you know? Option A: Straight up or down. Option B: Sweeps liquidity FIRST. Option C: Stays flat. Wait for the sweep. Wait for the order block retest. Then enter. That's how funded traders survive NFP. Follow R2F Trading. We post ICT setups every single day. Link in bio — r2ftrading.com
